description: This file defines an Admin Controller class 'GeoZone' for handling events related to geographical zones in the OpenCart system. It contains methods to add, edit, and delete geo zones, generating tasks and updating country and zone data accordingly.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Admin Controller class handling event hooks for geo zone operations, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the after event of adding a geo zone, scheduling tasks to update geo zone info and associated countries.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the before event of editing a geo zone, updating tax info and country data, including handling removed zones.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the before event of deleting a geo zone, scheduling tasks to update tax info and handle country data for the deleted zone.
